title: Port scripts/park-primary.sh into susi workflow park-primary
goal: Parking the primary checkout at origin/main (and --sync-only, which every workflow check and hook runs) is Rust (susi workflow park-primary) through std::process::Command, with no sh, flock, awk or cygpath; scripts/park-primary.sh is a stub that execs susi so the hooks, the loop scripts and branches cut before the port keep working; susi workflow check calls it in process; tests/park_primary.rs pins the Rust behaviour through the stub and the binary, and a Windows test runs with Git's usr/bin off PATH
